## In short

Once a month the mainframe job INTCALC charges interest on card accounts. This plan replaces that one job with a
Java 21 / Spring Batch job on PostgreSQL 15 and leaves everything around it where it is. Because other mainframe jobs
and the online screens keep using the same files, the new job gets a fresh copy of four files before each run and
hands back two results: the new interest transactions and the updated account balances. The new job first has to
produce exactly what the old one produces - including its known oddities - on 7 recorded cases, then
on real cycles run side by side, before it takes over.

Every item below is **PROPOSED** and names the role that has to confirm it. Open business questions stay in the
decision register (12 rows) and release choices in [decisions-release.md](decisions-release.md)
(13 rows).

## Moving the data (26 items)

### Trial load

Copy the four input files into PostgreSQL once, outside any production run, to find data the mapping cannot hold.

| Id | Item | Status | Owner to confirm |
|---|---|---|---|
| TL1 | Unload TCATBALF, DISCGRP, CARDXREF and ACCTDATA to flat files with IDCAMS REPRO while the CICS files are closed, so the four files are from the same moment. | PROPOSED | mainframe operations owner |
| TL2 | Transfer the files in binary with their record length (50, 50, 50, 300); no character translation on the way. | PROPOSED | mainframe operations owner |
| TL3 | Load each file into its empty table in one transaction. A record that cannot be decoded goes to a reject list with file, record number and field; one reject fails the trial. | PROPOSED | data engineering lead |
| TL4 | Profile what the mapping gaps ask for: accounts with several cards (G08), mixed type codes (G06), minus zero (G03), F-signed amounts (G02), fillers that are not blank, accounts that are not active (INT-H04), balances without a rate and without a DEFAULT rate (INT-R08). | PROPOSED | data owner |
| TL5 | Run the trial on data approved for the environment; this repository holds synthetic data only. | PROPOSED | data owner |

### Reconciliation counts and sums

Figures that must be equal on both sides. Each is computed by the loader or the exporter and stored in interest_run.

| Id | Item | Status | Owner to confirm |
|---|---|---|---|
| RC1 | Row count of each of the four tables equals the record count of its unloaded file. | PROPOSED | data engineering lead |
| RC2 | Sums equal on both sides: ACCT-CURR-BAL, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT, ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT over accounts; TRAN-CAT-BAL over balances; DIS-INT-RATE over rates; and the sum of the account ids of each file as a hash total. | PROPOSED | data engineering lead |
| RC3 | Round trip: every loaded row, encoded again, equals its source record byte for byte. Differences are counted per gap id (G02, G03); any other difference fails. | PROPOSED | data engineering lead |
| RC4 | Keys: the number of distinct keys equals the row count in each table, and the lowest and highest key equal the first and last record of the file. | PROPOSED | data engineering lead |
| RC5 | After the calculation: the number of rows written to interest_transaction equals the records in the exported SYSTRAN generation, and the sum of TRAN-AMT equals the change of the sum of ACCT-CURR-BAL plus the interest of the last account (which is not added, INT-Q04). | PROPOSED | business owner |
| RC6 | After the write-back: ACCTDATA unloaded again equals the account table in count and in the five sums of RC2. | PROPOSED | mainframe operations owner |

### Side-by-side running

Both jobs process the same inputs; only the mainframe result is used.

| Id | Item | Status | Owner to confirm |
|---|---|---|---|
| SS1 | Off-host first: make parity-java passes the seven fixture cases field by field (ticket 09). | PROPOSED | engineering lead |
| SS2 | Shadow run per cycle: unload the inputs just before INTCALC, let INTCALC run as today, run the new job on the unload, and compare SYSTRAN, the ACCTDATA after-image and SYSOUT with the field-level comparator. The new job's output is not given to COMBTRAN. | PROPOSED | test lead |
| SS3 | Timestamps: the two runs happen at different moments (INT-Q03), so TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are compared for format only, or the new job is given the mainframe run's clock. The rule used is written into the comparison report. | PROPOSED | test lead |
| SS4 | Every difference is classified as a defect, an open decision (its id) or a mapping gap (its id). Exit needs REL-04 cycles with no defect and no unclassified difference. | PROPOSED | test lead |
| SS5 | The number of cycles and the bar for 'equal' are release decisions REL-04 and REL-05. | PROPOSED | business owner |

### Cutover

The cycle in which the new job's result is the one that is used.

| Id | Item | Status | Owner to confirm |
|---|---|---|---|
| CO1 | Preconditions: tickets 09 and 10 are closed, REL-01 to REL-13 are answered, and each row of the decision register is answered or accepted as coded. | PROPOSED | release manager |
| CO2 | Order inside the window: CLOSEFIL, back up ACCTDATA, unload the four files, load and reconcile (RC1-RC4), calculate, export, reconcile (RC5), write back ACCTDATA and catalog the SYSTRAN generation, reconcile (RC6), COMBTRAN, WAITSTEP, OPENFIL. | PROPOSED | mainframe operations owner |
| CO3 | Scheduler: the INTCALC definition in the folder is replaced by the job that starts the new run; it still adds the condition MONTHLY-InterestCalculation-INTCALC, so COMBTRAN is released as before. | PROPOSED | scheduler owner |
| CO4 | Go or no-go is taken after RC5 and before the write-back. Until then nothing on the mainframe has changed. | PROPOSED | release manager |
| CO5 | The legacy job and load module stay in place, unscheduled, for the period agreed in REL-13. | PROPOSED | mainframe application owner |

### Fallback

What happens if the cutover run is not accepted, by the point reached.

| Id | Item | Status | Owner to confirm |
|---|---|---|---|
| FB1 | Before the write-back: abandon the new run and run the legacy INTCALC in the same window. Nothing on the mainframe needs restoring. | PROPOSED | mainframe operations owner |
| FB2 | After the write-back and before COMBTRAN: restore ACCTDATA from the backup of CO2, delete the cataloged SYSTRAN generation, run the legacy INTCALC. | PROPOSED | mainframe operations owner |
| FB3 | After COMBTRAN or OPENFIL: no technical fallback. Corrections are posted as transactions; that is a business decision (REL-07). | PROPOSED | business owner |
| FB4 | FB1 and FB2 are rehearsed once during the side-by-side period. | PROPOSED | test lead |
| FB5 | On the PostgreSQL side the run is marked ABANDONED in interest_run; the replica tables are replaced by the next load. | PROPOSED | engineering lead |
